title: GTA6 Release Countdown: What Are Players Playing This Weekend?
description: With less than two weeks until Rockstar's GTA6, players are in the evacuation zone. See how gaming editors are passing the time this weekend.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## In the GTA 6 Evacuation Zone

Another week has come to a conclusion, and the gaming community is very much in the GTA 6 evacuation zone now. There are less than two weeks remaining until Rockstar Games' highly anticipated sequel finally lands in our hands, folks.

As the excitement reaches a fever pitch, gamers and industry writers alike are finding various ways to kill time while waiting for the monumental launch.

### Finding Diversions Before the Launch

Push Square editor Jamie O'Neill shared a glimpse of how he is spending this crucial pre-launch weekend. Having only managed to log about three hours into Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut, he plans to break out the PS Vita. As he put it, he simply cannot leave that masked protagonist stranded in a disease-riddled city any longer.

## Editor's Take

Waiting for a generational release like GTA 6 is a unique experience. Whether you are diving into handheld classics on the PS Vita to kill time or simply replaying past Rockstar titles, these final two weeks feel both agonizing and thrilling. Hang in there, everyone—the wait is almost over.
